chapter: Parisian Room and Bourbon Street clubs
title: Whether bands used a tip kitty
summary: Neither saw a kitty on Bourbon Street; tips were handed to the band directly.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Yeah. Well. Uh, was there a kitty at, uh, El Moronco, at Manning's? Do you remember? I think there was. Seems to me there was. I'm pretty sure there wasn't at El Moronco. No. At least not an obvious one. Yeah.

I've never seen a kitty on Bourbon Street there, I remember. Well, that's my, my impression too. Well, you could tip the van if you wanted to, I'm sure. Yeah. And I've seen it done, but I've never seen a kitty. And you assume the tips reached a van? Yeah.
Well, sometimes people reached over and handed it to.
Yeah. The van, in which case I assume they reached the van.
